headline: The Four Pillars
subtext: Our strategic areas of work — each a root that anchors the sapling.

items.title: AI & Education Research
items.description: Analyze how AI transforms knowledge transmission and advocate for educational equity — publishing findings openly for the community.

items.title: Student Growth Center
items.description: Deliver AI skills training, resume optimization, and job-seeking strategies tailored to an AI-powered economy — meeting students where they are.

items.title: Innovation Incubation Engine
items.description: Identify new AI-enabled pathways and host innovation competitions that spark creativity, rewarding bold ideas from underrepresented voices.

items.title: Community Endorsement Program
items.description: Invite industry experts and distinguished speakers for lectures and project evaluations, raising the professional credibility of student work.
